reason: The launch review found that EXP004 protocol amendment 004 had already validated per-device microbatch 2 on L4 as 43.92% faster at fixed effective batch size 16. The EXP005 multinode launcher had not exposed that execution setting and was still using microbatch 1.
impact: No scientific training result was produced. About nine minutes of setup elapsed before both nodes were explicitly stopped.
resolution: Add a tested per-device microbatch execution override that preserves effective batch size, benchmark microbatch 2 on the selected two-node topology, and relaunch the exact stage only if the benchmark passes.
